findings.reason: the table must be placed in `imas_ambix/data/paths.py` (the owner §17 already edits for the map directory) and both §18 references corrected before a node can be dispatched, or §17 and §18 will put one path-resolution concern in two modules.
findings.text: §18 names the machine-to-package table's home as `imas_ambix/paths.py`, "beside the map directory §17 defines there", and repeats `imas_ambix/paths.py` in its write-path list, but no `imas_ambix/paths.py` exists (`test -f imas_ambix/paths.py` fails; the package root has no `paths` module) and §17 fixes the map directory in `imas_ambix/data/paths.py` — the module that today owns ambix's map-path constants (`BUNDLE_ROOT`, `PACKAGED_MACHINE_MAP_ROOT`, `PACKAGED_MAP_ROOT` at imas_ambix/data/paths.py:22-24) and is §17's declared write path; the "beside ... there" clause and the write-path list contradict each other, and a released node would either create a second path-resolution module beside the owner or edit a file outside §17's owner.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `imas_ambix/maps_cli.py` hides the tag listing (one function) plus the copied state machine, the release digest, the oras push and the guarded pull behind three click commands, so the behaviour is behind an interface smaller than what it hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §18 places the machine-to-package table in `imas_ambix/paths.py`, a module that does not exist, away from the path-resolution owner §17 fixes (`imas_ambix/data/paths.py`, `imas_ambix/data/paths.py:22-24`).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §18's "Accounting for the new surface" paragraph names the installer's private pull path as merged into `maps pull`, states `release`/`status` have no existing command to retire, and states the single new refusal cannot be retired because the local tree is the only copy.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §18 cites the machinery §18 copies or replaces: the state machine in `imas_codex/cli/release.py` (`compute_next_version`, `_get_latest_tag`, `_get_latest_stable_tag`, `_tag_exists` — all verified present at imas_codex/cli/release.py:153, :29, :45, :87, and all three tag query functions do run `git tag`), the parallel machine in `imas_codex/standard_names/catalog_release.py`, and the pull owner it retires at `packages/imas-alambic/install/imasdb.sh:44,70`; no search gap found.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one wrapper-shaped addition, `maps pull` over the installer's private oras pull, is justified in its own text as a merge that gives the registry, the auth form and the artifact type one owner, and imasdb.sh is a declared write path; the section also explicitly declines a `release_if_changed`-style helper rather than adding one.
